{{Quote|My deputy minister of trade, perishable goods, was in a suite above mine. I shot her in the foot while she was entertaining a guest.|Jagged Fel|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
An individual served as a '''deputy minister of trade''' for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]<ref name="Backlash" /> in [[43 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> and was [[Deputy minister of trade|responsible]] for perishable goods. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], she was stationed at the [[Galactic Empire Embassy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On one occasion, she was entertaining a guest in one of the embassy's rooms, when a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot breached the floor of the apartment and hit her in the [[Limb/Legends|foot]], causing her to scream and curse.<ref name="Backlash" />

The shot had been fired from the quarters below by Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], who was fending off a [[Kidnap attempt in the Galactic Empire Embassy Complex|kidnapping attempt]] and was trying to trigger the building's alarm. The shots did attract help, and the attempted kidnapping failed as a result.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Behind the scenes==
This deputy minister of trade was mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', the fourth book in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="Backlash" />
